name: context-kit
description: A three-tier context layout plus a lean execution ruleset, for any coding project. Bootstraps CLAUDE.md on first session, injects a short reuse-first ruleset into every session and subagent, captures repeatable procedures as skills on its own, and audits the layout with /context-init. Use when setting up, trimming, tiering or reorganizing a project's context, or when Claude is being wasteful.
